description:
​【Important Update from NeuR. ✨】

​Hello to all my precious fans... I have some heartbreaking news to share. 💔

Currently, I'm facing unfair account restrictions due to a system error on YouTube. I filed an appeal with all my heart, but sadly, it was not accepted. 🥺

​To be honest, I'm feeling a bit lost about how to share my art with you next. But I absolutely don't want our bond—this beautiful community of over 10k people—to end here! 🕊️💖

​I will be sharing all updates and my future plans on X (Twitter). Please follow me there so we can stay together! I'll be waiting for you. 🎀

​🔗 Follow me on X:

https://x.com/Gallery_NeuR



"A Town of Warmth and Kindness 1" was born from a desire to step away from the stresses of modern society and cherish the heartwarming feelings we all carry within us.

Experience a nostalgic and gentle atmosphere found in subtle gestures and everyday expressions. Please enjoy this world of kindness, woven together by AI art and music.

🎧 This is not background music.
It is an immersive visual music experience designed for deep listening and quiet reflection.Headphones recommended.

This work incorporates AI-generated visuals (Midjourney, Kling AI / Veo 3) and original AI-assisted music (Suno AI), brought together through independent editing and creative direction.

Let the mystical yet playful soundscape and surreal visuals guide you into the space between reality and dreams.

Legal: All music and visuals in this video are original works by AI Dreams Gallery NeuR © 2026.
Unauthorized use or reposting is prohibited.
